facts.fact: The page is dated May 5, 2023 (written as 05.05.23).
The page defines Meta advertising as placing ads on meta-search engines, a definition that conflicts with the standard meaning of Meta as the company behind Facebook and Instagram.
facts.quote: Meta advertising is a form of digital advertising that involves placing ads on meta-search engines.

facts.fact: The page states that advertisers pay only when a user clicks an ad, which it calls pay-per-click advertising.
facts.quote: The advertiser pays only when a user clicks on the ad, which is known as pay-per-click advertising.
